subject: ZephyrHealth POC — workload handoff & gating checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@zephyrhealth.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: ZephyrHealth POC — initial profile + next steps

Hi Anika / Tom —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get us to a short POC (2 weeks) that validates performance and cost at your expected peak patterns. Please confirm or flag changes.

Key items from the call:
- Goal: validate cost/latency at your live peak (billing flow) and a representative outpatient triage workload.
- Success criteria (proposal): p95 latency < 250ms for single-turn inference at 512 tokens; end-to-end SLA for return traffic < 500ms for typical payloads; throughput able to sustain 1200 RPS burst for <= 30s with graceful degradation policies.
- Model: open checkpoint X-1.2 (quantized) as baseline; fall back to X-1.0 for high concurrency.

Workload profile we need you to confirm in the attached matrix:
- steady-state RPS (requests/sec)
- median token length and 95th pct token length (input + expected output)
- concurrent sessions (hot KV reuse patterns)
- burst shape: expected peak RPS, duration, frequency (e.g., hourly spikes, once per day, etc.)
- payload examples for both short/long paths (attach sample payloads)

Immediate next steps:
1) Please fill columns A–F in zephyr_poc_matrix.xlsx (attached) with metrics you can share by EOD Fri 3/2.
2) SRE: paste two representative request JSONL lines into sample_payloads.jsonl (or drop to my Drive link).
3) We'll schedule a short tech handoff (30m) with Redwood infra and your SRE to agree on connectivity, auth, and telemetry hooks — propose Tue 4/5 14:00 PT; let me know if that works.

I've looped in Aditya (runtime) and Marcus (solutions) — they will own the benchmark run and evaluation readout.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai
Attachment: zephyr_poc_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: sample_payloads.jsonl (application/jsonl)
From: Anika Rao <anika@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@zephyrhealth.com>, sre@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZephyrHealth POC — initial profile + next steps

Thanks Soojin — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side:

- Steady-state: ~220 RPS during business hours (08:00–18:00 local).
- Burst: shopping/booking window causes spikes up to ~1.1k RPS for 20–30s, usually once every 2–3 hours.
- Tokens: median request payload ~120 input tokens; typical output ~80 tokens. 95th pct combined (in+out) ~900 tokens.
- Concurrency: we see ~350 concurrent sessions with KV reuse for repeat lookups; cold-start paths are small but matter for tail latency.

Tom (SRE) will paste two payload examples to the Drive link tonight. We'll fill the matrix by Friday morning.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood will simulate KV cache hit rates? We want to understand the difference in results if cache hit is 90% vs 50%.

Anika
Head of Digital Platforms | ZephyrHealth
Anika.Rao@zephyrhealth.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@zephyrhealth.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: ZephyrHealth POC — initial profile + next steps

Anika — perfect, thanks for the numbers (that helps a lot). A couple follow-ups and a short plan update: 

- We will include two benchmark passes: (A) KV-hit heavy (90% hit) and (B) KV-miss heavy (50% hit). We'll report delta on p50/p95/p99 latency and token cost delta.
- For the burst window we will run a calibrated synthetic test to exercise 1.1k RPS sustained for 30s, then a scaled ramp-down to validate graceful degradation behavior.
- Owners: Redwood infra (Aditya) will run the benchmarks; Solutions (Marcus) will map the success criteria to your business checks; Zephyr SRE (Tom) to validate environment and auth.

Attached is the POC gating checklist (lightweight) in the XLSX. Please drop the completed matrix back and paste two representative JSONL lines into sample_payloads.jsonl.

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 4/2: Zephyr returns completed matrix + payloads (you confirmed Friday morning)
- Mon 4/5: Tech handoff 14:00 PT (30m)
- Tue 4/6–Wed 4/7: Redwood runs benchmark passes and shares an initial readout by EOD Wed
- Thu 4/8: Joint readout and success-decision meeting (30m)

If that timeline is tight, we can push the bench to the following week, but earlier gets you faster confidence.

Thanks — will lock the handoff slot once you confirm Tom can join.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Rao <anika@zephyrhealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, sre@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZephyrHealth POC — initial profile + next steps

> Attached is the POC gating checklist (lightweight) in the XLSX. Please drop the completed matrix back and paste two representative JSONL lines into sample_payloads.jsonl.

Thanks all — confirming:
- Matrix filled and uploaded to your Drive link: https://drive.google.com/zephyr-poc/filled_matrix.xlsx
- Sample payloads pasted into sample_payloads.jsonl (two lines) — see attachment stub below.
- Tom (me) will join the handoff Tue 4/5 14:00 PT.

Notes on the provided numbers (SRE observations):
- We cannot share exact user-identifiers; payloads are sanitized.
- Cold-path requests tend to include additional auth lookups; please include an optional 40ms auth stub in the synthetic runs to simulate our stack.
- We'll expect a short (15–30 min) coordination window during the bench run to flip collection toggles and confirm metrics.

Next: please confirm the final test plan + start window for Tue 4/6 morning (your side).

Thanks,

Tom Hayes
Senior SRE | ZephyrHealth
